items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Response call from Dangerfield outlet regarding a female who is being rude towards staff members and causing a disturbance.

Arrived at Dangerfield outlet, manager informed us who the person of interest is. We spoke to her and informed her she had to depart the premises due to her behaviour displayed against staff, she complied with our orders and left the store. Standing by outside Dangerfield outlet as the female is still outside the premises and is threatening to come back to the store and start a protest.
Female person of interest has departed the premises. Informed managers she has moved along and that if she returns to give us a call back.
